ns2:course.label: Intro to Afro-American Studies
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary introduction to the basic concepts and literature in the disciplines covered by Afro-American studies; surveys the major approaches to the study of Afro-Americans across several academic disciplines including economics, education, psychology, literature, political science, sociology and others
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: UIUC Social Sciences, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
